item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'test_dir=$(mktemp -d)
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$test_dir/tasks.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title "  Plan release  " --tags "Work,urgent,work" --due 2026-09-10
bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Archive docs" --tags docs --due 2026-09-01
bun run src/cli.ts done 1
bun run src/cli.ts done 1
bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --overdue 2026-09-05
bun run src/cli.ts list --tag work
bun run src/cli.ts stats
bun run src/cli.ts delete 2
bun run src/cli.ts list
if bun run src/cli.ts add --title "" >/dev/null 2>"$test_dir/error"; then exit 1; fi
if bun run src/cli.ts list --bogus x >/dev/null 2>>"$test_dir/error"; then exit 1; fi
if bun run src/cli.ts done 99 >/dev/null 2>>"$test_dir/error"; then exit 1; fi
if bun run src/cli.ts add --title x --due 2026-02-29 >/dev/null 2>>"$test_dir/error"; then exit 1; fi
printf '"'not-json' > \""'$test_dir/bad.json"
if TASKBOARD_FILE="$test_dir/bad.json" bun run src/cli.ts list >/dev/null 2>>"$test_dir/error"; then exit 1; fi
rg -N '"'"'^'"' \""'$test_dir/error"
rm -rf "$test_dir"'
